interface.signature: def nthCharacter(S: str, R: int, N: int) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all(c in '01' for c in S) and 1 <= len(S) <= 1000
preconditions.description: S is a non-empty binary string with length between 1 and 1000.
R is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and 0 <= N < len(S) * (2 ** R)
preconditions.description: N is a non-negative integer strictly less than the length of the string after R iterations.

postconditions.description: The return value is the character at index N of the string obtained by applying the transformation rules R times to S.
